Über uns
Rain for Rent International ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen und spezialisiert auf Lösungen im Bereich temporäres Flüssigkeitsmanagement. Mit Standorten in Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Frankreich und dem Vereinigten Königreich unterstützen wir unsere Kunden mit innovativen Lösungen in den Bereichen Tankvermietung, Pumpen, Filtration und Rückhaltung.
Unsere Kunden kommen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen, darunter Chemie, Energie, Infrastruktur, Fertigung, Umwelttechnik und Bauwesen. Sicherheit, Kundenorientierung und technische Kompetenz stehen dabei im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns.
Zur Unterstützung unseres weiteren Wachstums in Europa suchen wir einen engagierten Business Development Manager (m/w/d) für die Region Süddeutschland.

Warum Rain for Rent International?
Bei Rain for Rent International werden Sie Teil eines Unternehmens mit über 90 Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich temporärer Flüssigkeitsmanagement-Lösungen.
Wir bieten Ihnen ein unternehmerisches Umfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative geschätzt wird und Sie die Möglichkeit haben, aktiv zum Wachstum unseres europäischen Geschäfts beizutragen. Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, Kunden zu begeistern, neue Märkte zu erschließen und in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
Rain for Rent International steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer oder sozialer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität.
Sollten Sie im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder eine angemessene Anpassung benötigen, teilen Sie uns dies bitte mit. Wir setzen uns für einen fairen und barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozess ein.

New Business Development : Engage with new strategic accounts to uncover new revenue opportunities and develop customised solutions that meet the needs of Enterprise prospects (+501 FTEs in Germany).

Pipeline Generation : Work closely with our Sales Development team to strategise on opening new opportunities as well complete personal pipeline generation to ensure steady and consistent pipeline.
Account Strategy Developmen t: Develop and implement strategic account plans that focus on delivering impactful business outcomes—whether improving talent attraction, enhancing spend efficiency, or reducing Private Medical costs.
Industry Engagement: Represent Wellhub at key industry events, forums, and conferences, showcasing our vision and capabilities in shaping the future of Employee Wellbeing.

Proven Success in SaaS Sales: Experience in enterprise sales new logo acquisition(501+ FTEs in Germany ) with a strong track record of driving revenue growth and working on ticket sizes of £100K - £500K+.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

Gestalte mit uns datengetriebene B2B Sales und GTM Strukturen
Du möchtest im Vertrieb nicht nur bestehende Leads bearbeiten, sondern moderne Go to Market Systeme aktiv mitentwickeln? In dieser Rolle verbindest du Business Development mit datenbasiertem Prospecting, AI Tools, automatisierten Workflows und strukturierten Outbound Prozessen.
Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Director entwickelst du skalierbare Prozesse für ein modernes B2B SaaS Umfeld. Du recherchierst und qualifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen, analysierst Märkte und Ansprechpartner, arbeitest mit CRM und Sales Tools und entwickelst personalisierte Outreach Sequenzen über verschiedene Kanäle.
Neben der operativen Ansprache potenzieller Kunden führst du kurze Discovery Calls, dokumentierst relevante Daten sauber im CRM und unterstützt dabei, Lead Scoring, Datenanreicherung, Automatisierungen und Übergaben an den weiteren Sales Prozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Du passt zu uns, wenn du Vertrieb als Zusammenspiel aus Kommunikation, analytischem Denken, Prozessverständnis und Technologie begreifst und Lust hast, moderne Sales Infrastrukturen aktiv mit aufzubauen.
Aufgaben

s.t:
Business Development & Outbound Sales: Du recherchierst und identifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen, erstellst strukturierte und datenbasierte Prospecting-Listen und sprichst potenzielle Kunden gezielt über E-Mail, LinkedIn und Telefon an. Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Director entwickelst du daraus eine belastbare und skalierbare Sales Pipeline.
Opportunity Development & Qualification: Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche und Discovery Calls, analysierst Anforderungen, Use Cases und Entscheidungsstrukturen und qualifizierst Opportunities anhand klarer Kriterien für die nächsten Schritte im Sales-Prozess.
AI-gestütztes Prospecting: Du kombinierst moderne Research-Methoden, Datenquellen, Buying Signals und AI-basierte Personalisierung, um passende Zielkunden effizient zu identifizieren, relevante Ansprechpartner zu priorisieren und qualifizierte Gespräche vorzubereiten.
Outreach & Messaging: Du entwickelst zielgruppenspezifische Outreach-Sequenzen und optimierst Messaging, Targeting, Personalisierung und Kanalwahl kontinuierlich auf Basis von Kampagnen-, Engagement- und Performance-Daten.
CRM & Pipeline-Steuerung: Du strukturierst und pflegst HubSpot zuverlässig, dokumentierst Aktivitäten, Kontakte und Opportunities transparent und schaffst damit die Grundlage für eine datenbasierte Steuerung von Outreach, Forecast und Deal-Fortschritten.
Automationen & Go-to-Market-Prozesse: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von Clay-Workflows und verbindest HubSpot, Clay sowie weitere Outreach-, Daten- und GTM-Tools zu effizienten Prospecting- und Automatisierungsprozessen.
Testing & Optimierung: Du konzipierst und testest neue Kampagnen, Sequenzen und Workflows, wertest die Ergebnisse systematisch aus und optimierst Prozesse auf Basis relevanter Kennzahlen, um Effizienz, Datenqualität und Conversion Rates nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Qualifikation

Erfahrung im modernen Business Development: Du bringst 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Business Development, SDR Umfeld oder B2B Sales mit. Strukturierte Zielkundenrecherche, Prospecting, Outreach sowie Erstgespräche und Discovery Calls gehören für dich zum Vertriebsalltag.
Sicherheit im modernen GTM Stack: Du hast bereits mit modernen Sales, CRM und GTM Tools gearbeitet, insbesondere mit HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator sowie Plattformen wie Lemlist, Apollo oder vergleichbaren Lösungen. Idealerweise kennst du auch datenbasierte Workflows zur Recherche, Anreicherung und Priorisierung von Leads.
Kommunikation mit Relevanz: Du kommunizierst klar, präzise und zielgruppengerecht, schriftlich wie mündlich. Du verstehst, wie personalisierte Ansprache, relevante Trigger und überzeugendes Messaging im modernen Outbound zusammenspielen.
Struktur, Ownership und Lernbereitschaft: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Gleichzeitig bist du bereit, dich schnell in neue Tools, Datenquellen, Prozesse und technologische GTM Ansätze einzuarbeiten.
Technologie und AI Affinität: Du interessierst dich für moderne Prospecting und Go to Market Prozesse und verstehst den Mehrwert von AI gestütztem Research, automatisierter Datenanreicherung, Personalisierung und datenbasiertem Outbound. Erste Erfahrungen mit Clay, Workflow Automationen oder vergleichbaren Tools sowie Kenntnisse aus SaaS oder Startup Umfeldern sind ein Plus.
Wichtig für uns: Du musst kein fertiger GTM oder Automatisierungsprofi sein. Entscheidend ist, dass du moderne Outbound Prozesse verstehst, gerne mit Kunden sprichst, strukturiert mit Daten und Tools arbeitest und Lust hast, Sales, Technologie und skalierbare GTM Prozesse miteinander zu verbinden.

Hohe Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung für eigene Themen, Kampagnen und Prozesse. Wir vertrauen auf Eigeninitiative, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und schnelle Umsetzung.
Moderner GTM und AI Stack: Du arbeitest mit modernen Sales, Daten und Automatisierungstools wie HubSpot, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lemlist, Apollo sowie weiteren Lösungen für Research, Datenanreicherung, Prospecting und Outreach.
Performanceorientierte Kultur: Wir arbeiten ambitioniert, datenbasiert und mit einem klaren Fokus auf messbare Ergebnisse. Gute Ideen, Ownership, saubere Prozesse und kontinuierliche Optimierung zählen bei uns mehr als Hierarchien oder Titel.
Direkte Kommunikation und schnelle Entscheidungswege: Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, transparent und mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen. Entscheidungen werden schnell getroffen, neue Ansätze zügig getestet und Ergebnisse direkt in die weitere Optimierung überführt.
Noch wichtig: Auch wenn du bei uns vollständig remote arbeitest, muss sich dein dauerhafter Arbeitsort in Deutschland befinden. Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist in dieser Position nicht möglich.

Als Founding Account Executive (f/m/d) bist du maßgeblich dafür verantwortlich, die kommerziellen Grundlagen für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase zu schaffen. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, in einem entscheidenden Moment uns in unserer Unternehmensentwicklung zur #1 Klaviyo-Agentur in der DACH-Region zu unterstützen.
Du wirst Teil eines etablierten Teams mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und arbeitest gemeinsam mit über 400 führenden E-Commerce-Marken, darunter JUNGLÜCK, Giesswein, Reishunger, mammaly und Paul Hewitt. Gemeinsam bringen wir Mailody auf das nächste Level!
Diese Rolle bietet dir die Chance, unternehmerisch zu denken und zu handeln sowie auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit vielen Freiheiten erfolgreich zu sein. Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht einfach nur den nächsten Sales-Job sucht, sondern etwas Außergewöhnliches mit aufbauen möchte.
Wenn dich Eigenverantwortung, hohe Ansprüche an deine eigene Leistung und die Möglichkeit motivieren, die Zukunft eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten, wirst du dich bei Mailody wohlfühlen. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Founder zusammen, entwickelst unser Commercial Playbook aktiv mit und hast einen klaren Entwicklungspfad in eine Führungsrolle, sobald unser Sales-Team weiter wächst.
Aufgaben
Du bist für den gesamten Sales Cycle verantwortlich – von der Identifikation potenzieller Kunden und dem Aufbau einer qualifizierten Pipeline über Verhandlung und Abschluss bis zur Übergabe an unser Onboarding-Team.
Du gestaltest aktiv das Commercial Playbook, das zukünftigen Sales-Mitarbeitenden als Grundlage dient – von Positionierung und Pricing bis hin zu Prozessen, Tools, Reporting und Sales Enablement.
Du baust eine planbare Pipeline über Outbound-Aktivitäten, LinkedIn, Networking, Empfehlungen und strategische Partnerschaften auf.
Du führst beratende Verkaufsgespräche, identifizierst die tatsächlichen geschäftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und positionierst Mailody als langfristigen Wachstumspartner – nicht einfach als weitere Agentur.
Gemeinsam mit dem Founder entwickelst du unsere Ideal Customer Profile, unsere Positionierung und unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie kontinuierlich weiter – auf Basis von Kundenfeedback und Marktkenntnissen.
Du repräsentierst Mailody auf E-Commerce-Events, Networking-Veranstaltungen und Branchenkonferenzen und stärkst dabei sowohl deine persönliche Marke als auch unsere.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ambitionierte Umsatzziele und spielst eine entscheidende Rolle beim Aufbau eines leistungsstarken Sales-Teams.
Qualifikation
Du verfügst über mindestens zwei Jahre erfolgreiche Erfahrung im Vertrieb, beispielsweise als Business Development Representative, SDR oder Account Executive, und hast deine Vertriebsziele regelmäßig erreicht oder übertroffen.
Du kommunizierst auf muttersprachlichem Niveau in Deutsch sowie verhandlungssicher in Englisch (mindestens C1) – schriftlich wie mündlich.
Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Lösungen im E-Commerce-, SaaS- oder Digital-Marketing-Umfeld ist ein großer Vorteil.
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs ist willkommen. Entscheidend sind für uns jedoch deine Leistungsbereitschaft und deine Fähigkeit, erfolgreich zu sein.
Du hast ein echtes Builder Mindset. Du entwickelst gerne neue Lösungen, probierst Dinge aus und verbesserst bestehende Prozesse kontinuierlich.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Selbstorganisation. Du wartest nicht auf Anweisungen, sondern erkennst Chancen und übernimmst Verantwortung.
Rückschläge bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept. Du zeichnest dich durch Resilienz, Beharrlichkeit und Durchhaltevermögen aus.
Du bist von Natur aus neugierig, verfügst über ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Verständnis und interessierst dich dafür, wie Unternehmen wachsen und erfolgreich werden.

Attraktive Vergütung mit einem leistungsorientierten Bonusmodell, das deinen Beitrag und deine Ergebnisse belohnt.
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Foundern, die bereits mehrfach erfolgreich Unternehmen aufgebaut und skaliert haben.
Remote-First-Kultur mit der Flexibilität, von überall in Deutschland zu arbeiten und deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenverantwortlich zu gestalten.
50 € monatliche Sachbezugskarte nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der Probezeit.
Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßiges Coaching und vielfältige Möglichkeiten, deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung zu beschleunigen.
Regelmäßige Team-Offsites und Workations, bei denen wir gemeinsam arbeiten, voneinander lernen und Erfolge feiern.

Ease is hiring an Account Executive to help manufacturers improve quality, safety, and operational performance through our category-leading plant floor audit platform.

In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close, while partnering with some of the world's leading manufacturing organizations.

You'll join a growing team, sell a proven solution with strong market traction, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both our customers and the company's continued growth.

Position Summary As an Account Executive at Ease, you’ll own the full sales cycle for enterprise manufacturing prospects, from first conversation to signed contract. You’re the first face these organizations see, and the impression you leave sets the tone for everything that follows.

You’ll build relationships across the org, from the plant floor to the C-suite, and you’ll understand the difference between the two audiences well enough to speak to both without changing your conviction.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to move qualified deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up to win. If you’re a hunter who also knows how to build trust, asks better questions than you give answers, and measures success by the deals that actually close: this one is for you.

Salary: $200k+ OTE What You'll Do:
Prospect, qualify, and engage enterprise-level manufacturing organizations. You’re not waiting for leads to come to you. You know your ICP, you know where to find them, and you know how to earn the first conversation.
Build and manage a qualified pipeline. The majority of it will be self-sourced. Quality over volume. Know what’s real and what’s wishful, and have the discipline to tell the difference. A clean pipeline is a credible pipeline.
Run discovery that goes deeper than features and functions. Understand what a quality or safety problem actually costs the people in the room. Not just the business on paper, but the plant manager who’s been dealing with it for two years.
Deliver compelling product demonstrations that are tailored, not templated. The demo should feel like it was built for that customer, because it was. Show them their world in the product, not a generic walkthrough.
Partner with Marketing and Customer Success to move deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up for long-term success. The close isn’t the finish line. It’s the starting line.
Stay sharp on the manufacturing landscape: the pressures, the priorities, and the language of the people you’re selling to. The best reps in this space earn credibility on the plant floor, not just in the boardroom.
Own the full sales cycle. Prospecting through close. Negotiate with confidence, manage multiple stakeholders across the org, and drive deals to a decision, in either direction. Knowing when to walk away is part of the job.

3+ years of experience in a closing role, with a track record of winning new business in enterprise-level accounts. You know what it takes to move a complex deal and you’ve done it more than once.
Strong communication skills, but more importantly, strong listening skills. You ask the right questions and know how to create space for the prospect to arrive at the answer themselves.
Competitive and accountable, without needing external pressure to stay on track. You set your own standard, and it’s a high one. You also know when to walk away from the wrong deal and redirect your energy.
A consultative approach to discovery. You understand that the personal cost of a problem is just as important as the business case. You know how to find both, and you know how to connect them to the people making the decision.
Genuine curiosity about the manufacturing sector. You don’t need to be an industry veteran, but you need to be the kind of person who wants to understand how things are made, where the problems live, and what keeps a plant manager up at night.
Comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles. You know how to keep momentum without pushing. You build relationships across the org, not just with the person who signs the paper.
Proficiency with Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.

We are seeking a Founding Junior Account Executive (AE) : a full-cycle seller who owns deals end to end, from first signal through closed-won. Junior means you are earlier in your career and the deal sizes you will own are smaller than what our senior AEs run. Founding means you are shaping how RegASK sells to mid-market, and what you build becomes the foundation.
We hire full-cycle on purpose. You will prospect into your own book, run first meetings, lead discovery, demo, navigate buying committees, and close. Our GTM Engineer feeds you warm, signal-driven opportunities; you turn them into revenue.
You will sell into regulatory affairs, quality, and compliance leaders at mid-market companies across pharma, medtech, food, cosmetics, and chemicals. Cycles are shorter than our enterprise motion but still require real consultative selling: these are senior buyers in regulated industries who expect you to understand their world.

Pipeline: Own a defined book of target accounts and a pipeline target. Hit it.
Full-Cycle Sales: Prospect, discover, demo, negotiate, and close. You own every stage.
Outbound Engine: Build pipeline through AI-augmented outbound (email, LinkedIn, phone, video) on accounts where the GTM Engineer surfaces strong intent signals.
Inbound Conversion: Qualify and convert inbound leads from website, events, content, and paid channels.
Discovery: Run consultative discovery with senior regulatory, quality, and compliance leaders. Understand their compliance pain, map it to our platform, and articulate ROI clearly.
Demo: Lead live product demos. Sales engineering supports on the complex ones.
Deal Navigation: Drive multi-stakeholder buying committees across regulatory, IT, procurement, and legal to closed-won.
CRM Hygiene: Maintain Salesforce as your source of truth. Every account, contact, activity, opportunity, and stage logged accurately.
Coaching: Leverage tools for call review and self-coaching. Contribute to peer development.
GTM Partnership: Work closely with the GTM Engineer to test new signals, plays, and sequences. Feed insights back into the engine.
Playbook: Help define the mid-market playbook: ICP refinement, qualification criteria, demo flow, objection handling, and pricing patterns that future AE hires will inherit.

2–4 years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 12 months of closing experience as a full-cycle AE, AE Apprentice, or SDR-promoted-to-AE.
Track Record: Proven history of hitting and beating pipeline and revenue targets.
Consultative Selling: You can run a discovery call that surfaces real pain, not a feature demo. You can read a buying committee, adapt your approach, and know when to push and when to wait.
Modern Sales Stack Fluency: Hands-on with Salesforce, Gong Engage / Outreach / Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or ZoomInfo. You can build a list, enrich it, sequence it, demo on Zoom, log it in CRM, and analyse it in Gong without needing a manual.
High AI Fluency: You use Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent daily as a force multiplier: account research, call prep, follow-up drafting, proposal generation, and competitive intel. You can write a prompt that gets a useful answer, spot when output is wrong, and build small AI-powered workflows that save you hours per week.
Strong Written Communication: You can write an outbound email that does not sound like a template and does not sound like AI wrote it either. You can write a proposal that gets signed.
Complex Buying Environments: Comfortable selling to lawyers, scientists, and regulatory professionals across multi-stakeholder committees involving regulatory, IT, procurement, and legal.
Domain Curiosity: You do not need a science degree, but you genuinely want to understand what our customers do. A motivation to build expertise quickly is essential.
Self-Direction: Comfortable operating without a playbook in a fast-moving, founding-stage environment.
Language : Native or fluent business English plus at least one European language (French, Spanish, Italian, or German) preferred, to support effective engagement with prospects and counterparts in the region.

Experience selling into pharma, medtech, food, cosmetics, or chemicals.
Background in regulatory affairs, life sciences, or compliance.
Prior experience as part of a founding GTM team.
Hands-on experience building or maintaining GTM workflows, custom CRM reports, or AI agents (Clay, Apollo, Salesforce, or equivalent).
Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks (MDR, IVDR, REACH, EU AI Act, novel foods, or cosmetics regulation).

Impact: Your work compounds across the whole sales organisation. What you build today drives pipeline for the team every quarter going forward.
Growth: First-seat ownership, cutting-edge AI, and a culture that invests in learning and career development.
Culture: Diverse, agile, and mission-driven team across Canada, US, UK, EU, Singapore, Japan, and beyond.

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.
Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.
Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.
The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.
Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.
Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.
Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.
Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

n8n is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own and grow a defined enterprise territory across Northern Europe (UK&I, Nordics & Benelux) building pipeline, landing net-new logos, and expanding strategic accounts.
You’ll run a full-cycle, consultative enterprise motion (FTE 2,500+): uncovering technical and business needs, aligning multiple stakeholders, guiding evaluations, and closing high-impact six/seven-figure deals.
This role is ideal for someone who can sell to technical buyers (developers are our ICP), thrives in fast-growing environments, and uses a structured methodology (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC) to drive predictable outcomes.
What You’ll Be Doing
🎯 Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets across a defined Northern Europe enterprise territory
🧭 Build pipeline proactively (≥50%+ sourced by you) through outbound prospecting and smart territory/account planning
🔎 Run deep discovery and qualification using MEDDIC/MEDDPICC—uncovering pain, impact, decision process, decision criteria, and confirming real evidence before you forecast
🧱 Manage the full sales cycle end-to-end: discovery, demos, technical validation/evaluation, proposals, procurement, and negotiations
🧠 Translate technical value into business outcomes—aligning n8n’s automation + AI capabilities to measurable efficiency, risk reduction, and speed-to-delivery
🤝 Orchestrate multi-threaded deals across stakeholders (champions, technical evaluators, security, procurement, and economic buyers) to keep momentum and reduce stall risk
📝 Create and drive mutual action plans with customers—clear next steps, milestones, and shared accountability from first meeting to signature
📈 Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene, forecast accuracy, and account notes in CRM (Salesforce) communicating clearly and early about risks and next steps
🔗 Partner tightly with Solutions Engineering, SDRs, Marketing, RevOps, and Customer Success to accelerate deals and ensure strong handoffs for expansion
🌍 Represent n8n at events and in-market—building credibility with technical communities and enterprise leaders across Northern Europe (with customer travel as needed)

Must-haves
🏆 Enterprise SaaS sales track record: 5+ years in quota-carrying roles with consistent overachievement in enterprise segments
🌍 Northern Europe market expertise: Existing network and proven success selling into Northern Europe enterprises (plus relevant languages)
🧩 Complex deal leadership: Proven ability to close multi-stakeholder deals with longer cycles, procurement/legal steps, and high scrutiny
🔎 Methodology-driven execution (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC): You use structured qualification to build high-confidence pipeline and accurate forecasts
🗣️ Executive + technical buyer fluency: You can engage C-level stakeholders and also win credibility with technical audiences (DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops etc.)
🧠 Consultative selling: You lead with customer outcomes, ask sharp questions, and tailor your narrative to the customer’s reality—not a generic pitch
📊 Operational discipline: Strong CRM hygiene, forecast rigor, and a habit of using evidence to drive next steps and internal alignment
🤝 Collaboration mindset: You work smoothly with SE/CS/Marketing/RevOps and elevate the whole deal team, not just your own activity
Nice-to-haves
🧑‍💻 Open-source / community experience: You’ve sold in or alongside open-source ecosystems and understand bottoms-up adoption and PLG signals
🧪 Selling technical workflow/automation products: Experience with integration, API-first platforms, DevOps/SecOps/IT Ops, or adjacent categories
🚀 Early-stage / scale-up experience: You’ve helped build pipeline and playbooks in a fast-growing environment where process is evolving

主なミッションは、売上規模10億ドル（約1,000億円）以上の製造業を中心としたエンタープライズ企業群に対して、新規ロゴの獲得（New Logo Acquisition）と経常収益の拡大を推進することです。 特定少数のアカウントを深耕するのではなく、広範なターゲットリストに対してスピード感を持ってアプローチし、市場シェアを拡大する「ハンター」としての要素が強いロールです。

This is a Remote — European Union (multi-country), with travel across Europe and the Middle EastEverything happens somewhere — which is why spatial analytics is fundamental to companies trying to understand the “where” and the “why” of their business.

CARTO is the leading cloud-native location intelligence platform, trusted by data scientists, data analysts and developers from multiple National, State, and Local levels around the world to provide geospatial insights for use cases such as site selection, geomarketing, route optimization, network planning and much more.

With an exceptionally diverse team spread across the US and Europe, CARTO is changing the way companies analyze location data — making it simple to do this straight out of modern, cloud data warehouses. Redefining its category, the company has grown rapidly in recent years providing a compelling alternative to legacy GIS software.
CARTO is cloud-native by design: the platform connects directly to the data warehouses enterprises already run — Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks — so geospatial analysis happens where the customer’s data already lives , with no data movement.

And where sovereignty requires it, CARTO runs on open formats and open standards deployed on sovereign or on-premise environments. In a European market where digital sovereignty has moved from the IT backroom to the boardroom, that architecture is a decisive commercial advantage.
The opportunity European organizations are under intensifying pressure to keep sensitive data under EU jurisdictional control.

The EU Data Act, the AI Act, DORA and NIS2, the European Commission’s Cloud Sovereignty Framework, and national sovereignty initiatives have turned sovereignty into a procurement requirement — especially across government, defense, financial services, utilities, and critical infrastructure.

At the same time, a generation of legacy GIS is reaching end of life and being rebuilt for an AI-native world.
CARTO ’s architecture speaks directly to both shifts. Because analysis runs inside the customer’s own environment, on open formats and portable compute, CARTO helps customers stay AI-ready, avoid vendor lock-in, and keep control of their data. This role exists to turn that positioning into pipeline and revenue across Europe.
The role We are hiring an EU-based Business Development Manager to develop the market for CARTO ’s sovereignty proposition at the European level.

In this hunting, market-development role, you will open net-new logos, build and activate partner-led motions with cloud and sovereign-ecosystem players, and develop the public-sector and regulated-industry market where sovereignty requirements are most stringent — government, defense, national mapping and space agencies.

You will work across multiple EU countries rather than a single territory, with opportunities extending into the Middle East as the business grows. This is an individual-contributor role measured on qualified pipeline and closed ARR while you build the motion, ramping to a carried new-business quota as the segment matures.

You will report to the CRO organization and partner closely with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Legal/InfoSec.
You will
Develop the European sovereignty market for CARTO — identify, prioritize, and open net-new public-sector accounts across multiple EU countries where data sovereignty is a live buying driver.
Own the full sales cycle end to end: outbound prospecting, discovery, qualification, mission impact, RFP response — then drive deals through to close with the support of the broader team.
Build and activate partner-led pipeline with cloud data platforms (Google Cloud, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks) and the European sovereign-cloud ecosystem — including GAIA-X–aligned providers, sovereign cloud operators, and recognized boutique and large system integrators in the region — to co-sell into sovereignty-driven opportunities.
Develop the sovereign public sector market (national and state government, defense and civilian, national mapping and space agencies), navigating procurement, tenders, and framework agreements.
Position CARTO ’s architecture as a sovereignty advantage and translate EU regulation (EU Data Act, AI Act, DORA, NIS2, the Cloud Sovereignty Framework / SEAL levels) into concrete mission impact.
Treat procurement, RFPs, security questionnaires, and infosec reviews as routine parts of the motion — anticipate them, engage Legal/InfoSec early, and keep deals moving through them.
Map prospect organizations to build multi-threaded relationships with technical, commercial, and compliance decision-makers, up to and including the board-level and government sponsors who now own sovereignty decisions.
Build and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and forecasting in Salesforce; use Gong and the wider revenue stack to inspect and advance deals.
Feed the field back into the business — share sovereignty signals, competitive intelligence, and packaging feedback with Product, Marketing, and Partnerships to sharpen the EU go-to-market.
Travel across Europe (and occasionally the Middle East) for customer, partner, and industry events (approximately 40–50%).
You offer
We are deliberately open on background. Geospatial experience is an advantage, not a requirement — strong candidates may come from sovereign cloud, enterprise data/analytics, or public-sector and defense technology sales.
5+ year track record of success selling or developing new business for SaaS / data / analytics products in a quota-carrying role, preferably in the geospatial, data science, BI, cloud, or analytics space.
Demonstrable experience developing net-new markets or segments — you are a hunter who is comfortable creating pipeline from a standing start, not inheriting a book of business.
Working knowledge of the European digital sovereignty landscape — the EU Data Act, AI Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, the US CLOUD Act / FISA concerns that drive it, GAIA-X, and the EU Cloud Sovereignty Framework / SEAL assurance levels.
Public-sector go-to-market experience — familiarity with tenders, framework agreements, and procurement cycles is a strong plus.
Experience selling with and through strategic partners — cloud platforms and/or European sovereign-cloud providers, resellers, and system integrators.
Comfort with procurement-heavy sales: RFPs, security questionnaires, and infosec reviews are routine, not exceptions, and you know how to run them in parallel with the commercial motion.
A MEDDICC practitioner — formally trained and able to apply the methodology to qualify and secure complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
Understanding of the geospatial, GIS, analytics, and cloud marketspace, able to think strategically about competition, impact, and CARTO ’s role in the market.
Multi-country EU selling experience; fluent English plus at least one other relevant language (German, French, or another EU language) strongly preferred.
Proficient in the modern revenue stack: Salesforce, Gong, Apollo, LinkedIn, and others. Familiarity with consumption-based commercial models is a plus.

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.
You should apply if...
You are a proven deal-closer with a track record of carrying your own number and consistently hitting it.
You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.
You are technically fluent and can pick up how a product integrates with the systems around it, explain it accurately to a technical audience, and stay credible when the questions get detailed.
You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.
You are a strategic thinker who can build a territory plan from a blank page, defend the choices in it, and change it when the ground shifts.
You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
You are a self-starter who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
You are mission-driven and motivated by the chance to change how healthcare communication works across three nations at once.

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform , empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. The Opportunity
We're hiring a Growth Account Executive to own renewals and expansion across our SMB book of business. This is a high-velocity, transactional seat. You'll run a large number of deals at once, work them fast, and be measured on retention and net expansion.

This is distinct from our enterprise expansion team, who run deep strategic motions on a small set of accounts. Here, the game is speed, coverage, and creativity - spotting the usage signal that means a customer is ready to grow, getting to the right person, and closing it in weeks rather than quarters.

If you want a seat where you control your own outcomes, see the direct impact of your hustle, and get to sell a technical product to smart buyers in one of the fastest-moving categories in software, this is it.

Own a book of renewals end to end — forecast, negotiate, and close on time, protecting revenue and pushing for uplift where the value is there.
Drive mid-term expansion. Don't wait for the renewal date. Find, build, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities throughout the contract term.
Monitor usage as your primary signal. Live in the product and usage data. Know which accounts are consuming, which are stalling, and which are hitting limits — then act on it before anyone asks you to.
Run high-velocity cycles. Manage a high volume of concurrent, transactional deals without letting anything slip. Multi-thread quickly, get to decision-makers, compress timelines. Identify and de-risk churn early. Spot the leading indicators of a flat or declining account and mobilize the right internal resources to turn it around.
Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Support to remove blockers and land outcomes for customers.
Feed the machine. Bring patterns you see in the field back to Solutions, Product, and Sales. Your book is one of the best sources of signal in the company. Own the full expansion and renewal sales cycle across your book of business, executing a complex, value-based process that spans multiple stakeholders, teams, and use cases within each account.

A growth mindset. You seek out feedback, you're coachable, and you get measurably better every quarter. You'd rather be corrected than comfortable.
Grit. Transactional sales is a volume game with a lot of noise and a lot of no. You stay in it, you follow up again, and you don't get discouraged.
Creativity. Not every deal follows the playbook. You find non-obvious paths to the right stakeholder, non-obvious reasons to expand, and non-obvious ways to unstick a stalled account.
An act-like-an-owner mindset. Nobody has to hand you your priorities. You know your number, you know your book, and you go get it. When something's broken, you fix it or flag it - you don't wait.
A bias toward velocity. You'd rather close a smaller deal this week than a perfect one next quarter. You move fast without being sloppy.
Comfort with technical products and technical buyers. You don't need to be an ML engineer, but you need to be genuinely curious about AI and willing to learn the space deeply enough to be credible with engineering and data science teams.
Data fluency. You can pull, read, and act on usage and consumption data without waiting for someone to build you a dashboard.
Clear communication - written and verbal, with customers and internally.

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

We are seeking an ambitious, self-directed Sales Manager with a winning and growth mindset, a relentless hunter, ready to go out and build the business — to own revenue growth for Spire 's aviation portfolio and bundles across the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.
The role carries two tightly linked motions. The first is the partner ecosystem: owning and selling to the commercial defense contractors, systems integrators, application service providers, and data integrators that deliver national aviation, airspace, and security programs in these markets, the most frequent route to revenue. The second is direct sales to the civil aviation and defense agencies behind those programs.
Your customer landscape extends beyond civil aviation: maritime security, airspace security, and multi-domain awareness users are key potential customers for Spire's data across the region.

This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role for a seller who understands how governments and their delivery ecosystems buy through long procurement cycles, tenders, offsets, and partner-delivered programs.

Operating with the autonomy of a regional owner, you will establish Spire as the trusted aviation data partner across two of the fastest-growing aviation markets in the world, selling a product that is, quite literally, powered by space.
As Spire's portfolio expands, this role is also expected to grow into selling integrated products: Aviation + Weather and Aviation + RF geolocation (RFGL) signal-interference products — giving you more ways into every account.

Own the territory: Build and execute a territory plan spanning the Middle East and Asia-Pacific — mapping the contractor and integrator ecosystem, agencies, budgets, procurement vehicles, and prime relationships country by country, and prioritizing the opportunities with the highest revenue potential.
Hunt relentlessly and exceed targets: Meet and surpass assigned quota through proactive outbound prospecting, disciplined qualification, and full-cycle execution. This is a hunting role: you create demand rather than wait for it.
Sell to and through the partner ecosystem (B2B2G): Own relationships with commercial defense contractors, systems integrators, application service providers, and data integrators across the region — identifying, qualifying, and winning positions that embed Spire’s aviation data inside their programs, platforms, applications, and bids. Get onto bid teams before the tender publishes, secure teaming agreements, and make Spire the default data layer on recurring recompetes.
Build the reseller channel: Structure and negotiate reselling and distribution agreements with data integrators and software companies, creating a scalable indirect revenue engine alongside your direct business.
Sell direct to government (B2G): Uncover the operational needs of civil aviation authorities, ANSPs, defense and security agencies, maritime security and multi-domain awareness organizations, search and rescue organizations, transport ministries, and research institutions, and propose tailored solutions built on Spire’s global flight tracking, historical data, and analytics.
Navigate government procurement: Lead responses to tenders, RFPs, and RFIs; structure deals through direct contracts, teaming agreements, and reseller or integration partnerships; and manage long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with rigor and patience.
Master the product: Develop deep expertise across Spire’s aviation APIs and ADS-B coverage, historical flight datasets, and their applications in airspace monitoring and security, maritime and multi-domain awareness, airport and airline operations, SAR, safety oversight, and AI model development — to communicate compelling value to technical and executive audiences alike.
Grow into the integrated portfolio: As Spire’s offerings expand, position Aviation + Weather and Aviation + RFGL signal-interference integrated products in your accounts — capturing and qualifying customer demand signals today and feeding them to product and leadership to inform the roadmap and the timing of expansion.
Build lasting relationships: Develop trusted, long-term relationships with contractor, integrator, and software company executives and senior government stakeholders, understanding their missions, constraints, and objectives to position Spire for multi-year engagements.
Negotiate and close: Lead commercial negotiations on terms and pricing across government contracting frameworks, reseller and distribution agreements, and partner margins, reaching mutually beneficial deals and closing reliably.
Manage your pipeline: Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM, forecasting rigorously and following up on every lead, tender, and opportunity.
Know the market: Track government aviation programs, defense, airspace, and maritime security modernization initiatives, multi-domain awareness programs, competitive movements, and emerging opportunities across your regions to inform strategy and shape demand early — before tenders are published.
Represent Spire: Raise Spire’s profile at airshows, defense and security exhibitions, and ATM and ANSP forums across the Middle East and Asia-Pacific, generating qualified opportunities and strengthening the partner ecosystem.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with product, engineering, legal, and customer success teams to align solutions with customer requirements — including data sovereignty, security, and compliance considerations for government buyers — and feed market insight back into the product roadmap.

A winning and growth mindset: a relentless hunter who goes out and creates opportunities, thrives on outbound pursuit, and treats every account as expandable.
8+ years of experience in sales or business development selling data products, SaaS, or technology solutions in the Middle East and/or Asia-Pacific.
A proven track record selling through or alongside prime contractors, systems integrators, application service providers, resellers or data integrators (B2B2G) and to governments (B2G) — including positioning your solution as a subcontracted or embedded component of a partner-delivered program.
Experience structuring and negotiating reselling or distribution agreements with data integrators and software companies.
A demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets and quotas.
Domain fluency in aviation, aerospace, defense, maritime data, or geospatial data, or deep experience selling digital transformation and analytics into government, security, or research organizations.
The range to grow with the role: comfort expanding into commercial deal cycles and a broader, integrated product portfolio as territory scope evolves.
A consultative, value-based selling style with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, effective from working level to minister level.

As a Senior Mid-Market Growth Account Executive, you aren't just managing a portfolio; you are responsible for architecting the growth strategy within it. You will own the most complex, high-potential accounts in Colombia, turning messy business challenges into scalable movement solutions.
This isn't a \"business as usual\" account management role. It is high-stakes, fast-moving, and often ambiguous. We are looking for someone with a \"go-get-it\" attitude-someone who doesn't wait for a playbook but builds one.

Influence Without Authority: Collaborate across Product, Operations, and Marketing to unblock technical barriers and shape the future of the U4B platform based on your clients' real-world feedback.
